column3: “To his friend” is rendered “to my friends.”
The Hebrew is difficult; NASB renders “As prepared for those whose feet slip,” and the meaning is uncertain.
“Whom God has brought in his hand” is rendered “Whom God brings into their power”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Complain to the earth” is rendered “speak to the earth.”
“All flesh of humankind” is rendered “all mankind.”
“Shuts on a person” is rendered “imprisons a man,” and “it will not be opened” as “there can be no release.”
“Leading away counselors barefoot” is rendered “makes counselors walk barefoot.”
“Correction of kings” is rendered “bond of kings”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Leading away priests barefoot” is rendered “makes priests walk barefoot,” and “people long established” as “the secure ones.”
“Removing a lip” is rendered “deprives … of speech.”
